name: x402 Doctor
description: Checks x402 and MPP paid APIs before an agent pays: a $0.001 preflight (go / caution / no_go, plus the option that will settle), a free payee check (is every payTo really the seller's, through ERC-8004 or a Concordium badge), a $0.01 full diagnosis and the fix code for $0.05. Never pays the endpoint it checks.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

skills.name: Preflight
skills.description: Before paying an x402 endpoint: go, caution or no_go, with the reasons and the payment option that will settle.

skills.name: Payee check
skills.description: Is every payTo of an x402 endpoint really its seller's? Per payment option, verified against the seller's ERC-8004 agent or Concordium badge.

skills.name: Diagnose
skills.description: Every check of an x402 endpoint with pass, warn or fail and a fix hint, for sellers.
